  "summary": "These two-page minutes record a combined meeting of the Swatantra Party’s National Executive and National General Council, held in Madras on 29 November 1975 and circulated on 31 December. G.K. Sundaram chaired the meeting. The opening discussion reviews legal challenges to censorship, political developments in Orissa, Karnataka, Maharashtra, Tamil Nadu and Kerala, and the party’s possible cooperation with democratic opposition forces. The meeting also notes concern about the party’s symbol and debates whether opposition to the Congress should be pursued from within or through a broader alliance.\n\nThe unanimously adopted resolutions centre on opposition to the Internal Emergency and the detention of political workers, calling for the Emergency to be lifted and detainees released. They support forming a Janatha Front, demand that elections be held on schedule rather than extending the life of the Lok Sabha, and congratulate the Gujarat Janatha Front on its civic-election victory. The resolutions also mourn K. Kamaraj Nadar, express concern for Jayaprakash Narayan’s health, object to proposed Indian-Russian educational collaboration as potentially indoctrinating, and criticise controls, licensing, taxation and monetary measures that the meeting says have damaged savings, investment, production and employment.",
